R/ is PROV DEOR TR P XVI COS III

Denarius of Marcus Aurelius (AD 161 - 180), dating from AD 161 - 162, (Reece Period 8). The reverse legend is PROV DEOR TR P XVI COS III and it depicts Providentia standing left holding a globe and cornucopia. Mint of Rome. RIC III, page 217, number 51. Obv: Laureate bust right / IMP M AVREL ANTONINVS AVG. Rev: Providentia standing left holding globe and cornucopia / PROV DEOR TR P XVI COS III
